mapper.sql: SELECT JOB_EXECUTION_ID FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION WHERE END_TIME IS NOT NULL AND CREATE_TIME < #{baseDttm}
mapper.delete: /* ExecLogPurgeBatchMapper.deleteBatchStepExecutionContext 기준일시 이전 Step 실행 컨텍스트를 삭제한다. */ DELETE FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION_CONTEXT WHERE STEP_EXECUTION_ID IN ( SELECT STEP_EXECUTION_ID FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION WHERE JOB_EXECUTION_ID IN () )

/* ExecLogPurgeBatchMapper.deleteBatchJobInstance 실행 건이 하나도 남지 않은 JobInstance를 삭제한다. */ DELETE FROM BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE I WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION E WHERE E.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID )
